In .rwx/{frontend,tests,reflex-build,trunk-check}.yml the push trigger uses `event.git.branch == 'trunk-merge/**'`, an equality test, so the glob never matches and push checks only run on `main`. Found while auditing duplicate CI pipelines. Suggested fix: use a prefix match (verify RWX expression syntax, e.g. via `rwx lint`) in all four files, then confirm required statuses post on trunk-merge batch refs.

result.output: .rwx/frontend.yml:10: if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || event.git.branch == 'trunk-merge/**' }} .rwx/frontend.yml:13: # and trunk-merge/** batch refs; the default per-run status renames .rwx/reflex-build.yml:10: if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || event.git.branch == 'trunk-merge/**' }} .rwx/reflex-build.yml:13: # and trunk-merge/** batch refs; the default per-run status renames .rwx/tests.yml:10: if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || event.git.branch == 'trunk-merge/**' }} .rwx/tests.yml:13: # and trunk-merge/** batch refs; the default per-run status renames .rwx/trunk-check.yml:10: if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || event.git.branch == 'trunk-merge/**' }} .rwx/trunk-check.yml:15: # below post stable names on PR heads and trunk-merge/** batch refs **Plan** 1. In all four files, replace the second arm with the documented prefix-match function (regex `event.git.branch =~ '^trunk-merge/'` also works; `starts-with` is clearer): ```yaml if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || starts-with(event.git.branch, 'trunk-merge/') }} ``` Keep the trailing `/` so only true batch refs match (not e.g. `trunk-merge-foo`). 2. Validate with `rwx lint` on each file. Note it requires RWX Cloud auth (`rwx login`) — it errors locally without a token, so run it from an authenticated environment. 3. Verify end-to-end after the change lands: trigger the merge queue (or push a temporary branch named `trunk-merge/verify`) and confirm the five `RWX: *` contexts appear on that SHA within ~1–2 minutes via `api.github.com/repos/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template/commits//status`, per the re-verification note in `.trunk/trunk.yaml:365-374`. Only these four files reference `trunk-merge/**`; `.rwx/smoke-nightly.yml` and `.rwx/preview.yml` are unaffected.   ｜ [Implement a fix ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template/41?action=build) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template/actions/runs/41362493997/job/125015651544) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `glm-5p3-fast` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai) -- /usr/local/bin/rwx

content.text:
I changed the push trigger in all four files (`.rwx/frontend.yml`, `tests.yml`, `reflex-build.yml` and `trunk-check.yml`). The second arm now reads `starts-with(event.git.branch, 'trunk-merge/')` instead of `== 'trunk-merge/**'`. The trailing `/` means only real batch refs match, not something like `trunk-merge-foo`. I haven't committed anything.

I ran `rwx lint` on `tests.yml` only. It reported one warning, that a package version is outdated (2.2.0 vs 2.4.0), and nothing about the `starts-with` expression. I didn't lint the other three files, which have the same one-line change.

I haven't confirmed that required statuses post on trunk-merge batch refs. That needs a merge-queue run, or a temporary `trunk-merge/verify` branch, after this lands. The `RWX: *` contexts should appear on that commit.
